tooltip.aeroindustrial.machine.common: Right-click: open the machine interface. Shift+right-click: show AeroFlux and status. AeroFlux Crystal: charge 2500 AeroFlux.
tooltip.aeroindustrial.machine.2: Torque Resonator — accepts Create kinetic energy and GTCEu energy through a compatible power interface.
tooltip.aeroindustrial.machine.4: Vector Compressor — AeroFlux compression node. At up to 20% overload, it uses 25% less energy.
tooltip.aeroindustrial.machine.5: Sky Relay — stabilizes overload on nearby AeroFlux machines.
tooltip.aeroindustrial.machine.6: Inertial Accumulator — spends stored energy to suppress high overload.
tooltip.aeroindustrial.machine.8: Atmospheric Condenser — atmospheric technology node. Under open sky, passively harvests 40 AF/20t below 80% overload.
tooltip.aeroindustrial.machine.9: Mobile Refinery — processing node for mobile systems.
tooltip.aeroindustrial.machine.10: Vector Thruster — directionally spends AeroFlux to affect moving structures.
tooltip.aeroindustrial.machine.11: AeroFlux Capacitor — a high-capacity buffer that automatically feeds adjacent machines with low charge.
tooltip.aeroindustrial.machine.12: Mobile Dock — automatically draws AeroFlux when low and unloads into the network when overcharged.
tooltip.aeroindustrial.machine.13: Pressure Lattice — converts AeroFlux into reduced self-overload.
tooltip.aeroindustrial.machine.14: Aeronautical Conduit — directionally transfers AeroFlux through its front face.
tooltip.aeroindustrial.machine.15: Vector Frame — a local resonance anchor: for 10 AF/20t it reduces overload on itself and adjacent machines.
tooltip.aeroindustrial.item.aeroflux_cry: Primary AeroFlux carrier. Right-click a machine to charge it by 2500 AeroFlux.
tooltip.aeroindustrial.item.phase_foil: Phase material for future technology chains.
manual.aeroindustrial.core: AeroFlux is the internal engineering energy of AeroIndustrial modules.
manual.aeroindustrial.energy: Charge machines with AeroFlux Crystals or compatible energy systems.
manual.aeroindustrial.overload: Overload rises near high storage. Up to 20% overload processing is accelerated; from 80% the machine stabilizes. Stabilizers, capacitors, and frames help build resilient networks.
manual.aeroindustrial.machine: Right-click opens a machine interface. Shift+right-click shows status. Processing recipes are available in JEI. Progression: Flux Lattice → Torque Resonator / Phase Refiner → Vector Compressor → Sky Relay / Inertial Accumulator / Aero Forge → Atmospheric Condenser → Mobile Refinery → Vector Thruster → AeroFlux Capacitor → Mobile Dock → Pressure Lattice → Aeronautical Conduit → Vector Frame.
manual.aeroindustrial.integration: Torque Resonator accepts Create kinetic input. Vector Thruster couples to compatible moving structures.
manual.aeroindustrial.controls: Mouse wheel: turn pages. Esc — close.
tooltip.aeroindustrial.wrench: Right-click a machine to rotate it. Shift+right-click rotates it back.
config.aeroindustrial.sky_relay_upkeep: Sky Relay stabilization upkeep per 20 ticks
manual.aeroindustrial.tiers.1: T1 Flux Lattice — base lattice: while charged, consumes 1 AF/20t and reduces its own overload by 3 percentage points.
manual.aeroindustrial.tiers.2: T2 Torque Resonator — every 10t it accepts Create kinetic input and compatible GTCEu energy input.
manual.aeroindustrial.tiers.3: T3 Phase Refiner — processor; at up to 20% overload it gains processing acceleration up to 3 progress units/t.
manual.aeroindustrial.tiers.4: T4 Vector Compressor — processor; at up to 20% overload it reduces recipe energy cost by 25%.
manual.aeroindustrial.tiers.5: T5 Sky Relay — every 20t it stabilizes nearby machines by 1 percentage point, consuming 25 AF only when stabilization succeeds.
manual.aeroindustrial.tiers.6: T6 Inertial Accumulator — below 40% charge it draws up to 200 AF/20t (configurable) from an adjacent source above 80%; at 50+ AF and 30+% overload it spends 50 AF to reduce overload by 5%.
manual.aeroindustrial.tiers.7: T7 Aero Forge — industrial processor for production recipes.
manual.aeroindustrial.tiers.8: T8 Atmospheric Condenser — processor and atmospheric harvester: under open sky it gains up to 40 AF/20t below 80% overload.
manual.aeroindustrial.tiers.9: T9 Mobile Refinery — processor for the late production chain and mobile systems.
manual.aeroindustrial.tiers.10: T10 Vector Thruster — by default every 10t it spends 25 AF to impulse compatible moving structures; high overload reduces strength. If no Sable sub-level contains it, the fallback targets the nearest compatible entity within its configured radius.
manual.aeroindustrial.tiers.11: T11 AeroFlux Capacitor — active buffer: transfers up to 250 AF/20t (configurable) to any adjacent AeroFlux-capable storage below 50% charge, while preserving its configured reserve.
manual.aeroindustrial.tiers.12: T12 Mobile Dock — below 1/3 charge it draws up to 100 AF/20t (configurable); above 75% it can unload up to the same amount into adjacent AeroFlux storage.
manual.aeroindustrial.tiers.13: T13 Pressure Lattice — spends 20 AF/20t and reduces its own overload by 8 percentage points.
manual.aeroindustrial.tiers.14: T14 Aeronautical Conduit — transfers up to 100 AF/20t (configurable) only through its front face.
manual.aeroindustrial.tiers.15: T15 Vector Frame — spends 10 AF/20t, reduces its own overload by 2 percentage points and adjacent machines by 1.
